findings.invariant_violated: comparable elements must respond equally to the same influence
findings.description: Within a single shot and the same air, the breakfast plate emits a thick, continuous steam column while the coffee poured only seconds earlier (00:28-00:33) shows no steam at all — neither in the pour close-up nor in the wide shot where the plate beside it steams heavily. Two comparable hot, wet surfaces behave differently under identical conditions, and no material difference (mug ceramic vs. plate food) accounts for the total absence of the effect on the coffee.
